description: A tab panel set shows the content of the selected tab.

tags.devx: - Requires a `TabGroup` ancestor; otherwise it renders nothing (and warns).
tags.a11y:
- Renders a plain wrapper `div`; the `tabpanel` role and its `id`/
  `aria-labelledby` pair live on the connected `TabPanel`.
tags.limitations:
- Only the active panel is mounted; there is no offscreen preservation of
  the other panels' state.

className.name: className
className.description: Root classes (string), static element classes (object), or state-aware element classes (function).

tags.devx:
- Requires a `udx-tab-group` ancestor; otherwise it warns and every panel
  stays hidden.
tags.a11y:
- Renders a plain wrapper `div`; the `tabpanel` role and its `id`/
  `aria-labelledby` pair live on the connected `udx-tab-panel`.
tags.limitations:
- Unlike React, every projected `udx-tab-panel` keeps its component
  instance alive; inactive panels are hidden with the native `hidden`
  attribute instead of being unmounted.
- `[class.x]` and `[ngClass]` bind to the `display: contents` host and have no visible effect; use `class`, `[class]`, or `classes`.

hostClass.name: hostClass
hostClass.description: Classes applied to the root element. Angular's native `class` attribute and `[class]` binding land here, merged with the component's own classes.

classes.name: classes
classes.description: Static or state-aware classes for the component's internal elements, keyed by element name.
